title: filled next outline this page
rule: Standard (filled) for actions that go to a next step. Outline for actions that happen on the current page. Unstyled only for less important actions that may look like links.
pass_when: Next-step actions are filled; same-page actions are outline; unstyled is only for less important link-like actions.
fail_when: Filled used for a same-page action, outline used as the next-step control, or unstyled used as the primary next step.
overview: Filled buttons go to a next step; outline buttons act on the current page.
apply_when: Choosing filled versus outline button styles for navigation and page actions.
not_when: Using unstyled controls as the primary next-step action.
agent_hint: Use filled for next-step actions, outline for same-page actions, unstyled only for lesser link-like actions.
description: USWDS uses standard filled buttons for actions that go to a next step, outline for actions that happen on the current page, and unstyled only for less important actions that may look like links. Filled same-page actions, outline next-step controls, or unstyled primary next steps invert that hierarchy. Match style to whether the action leaves the page or stays.
do_not_claim: Actions one-primary / distinctive-primary as this row.
